This document complies with New Mexico student group classifications, and serves to provide the public with assessment performance data that is historically comparable with reports produced prior to the implementation of the Every Student Succeeds Act.  Consequently, the figures here will differ slightly from Achievement figures available via the New Mexico Student Spotlight.
